relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: In rats, orofacial pain after injury to the trigeminal nerve is alleviated after the suppression of sodium channel Nav1.7

key_findings: Review of the neuron-glia-immune triad and cortico-limbic circuits in pain, covering satellite glia, astrocytes, microglia, T cells, mast cells and neutrophils.
Sex differences in pain mechanisms remain understudied.
